Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
Please be so kind as to direct on this letter.
I am taking the [Chaplet of Pearls](../books.html#69) to have a final reading by its greatest critics[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Perhaps [Mary Anne Dyson](../persons.html#464) (who is known to have encouraged CMY to make Eustacie less adult) and her [sister-in-law](../persons.html#462).
